title: Gothic Candle Ritual
description: A blonde woman in a blue and black laced corset stands holding a lit candle while placing her hand on the shoulder of a kneeling brunette woman in a matching corset. They are positioned on a stone courtyard before a large Gothic cathedral with intricate architecture, surrounded by numerous lit candles and swirling blue ethereal smoke.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene showing a tall blonde woman in an ornate blue and black corset with lace details standing and holding a lit candle, her hand resting on the shoulder of a kneeling short-haired brunette woman wearing a matching corset. Both have pale skin and tattoos. They are on a stone paved courtyard in front of a towering Gothic cathedral at dusk, surrounded by many lit candles arranged on the ground with swirling blue magical smoke and particles in the air.
